author: reek
body: The capability gate. Verifies a page's declared effect profile against the user's trust decisions before allowing execution. Pages that exceed their granted capabilities are rejected at compile time (effect type mismatch) -- the sandbox is the runtime policy layer on top.

author: reek
body: The factory pattern for page embedding. An embedded page's capabilities are derived from the embedder's capabilities -- never escalated. Revocation cascades from parent to child.
